document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Every field trip is a rare opportunity that must be fought for. 
Miskatonic is a wonderful institution, but the discoveries that 
change the known world are made here, on its fringes, through 
painstaking and dangerous exploration. You cannot give up yet.

If the expedition still has all its personnel, go to 602. If only two 
students remain, go to 600. If Charlie alone has been lost, go to 604. 
If Bernard alone has been lost, go to 598.
